fields.label: p3109-codec-002

fields.label: p3109-codec-003

ceq [p3109-codec-005] : decode(F, C) = nan if validCode(F, C) /\ internalFormat(F) /\ C == nanCode(F) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .

fields.label: p3109-codec-006
fields.condition: validCode(F, C) /\ internalFormat(F) /\ DomainOf(F) == Extended /\ C == positiveLimit(F)

records.text: ceq [p3109-codec-006] : decode(F, C) = posInf if validCode(F, C) /\ internalFormat(F) /\ DomainOf(F) == Extended /\ C == positiveLimit(F) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .

fields.label: p3109-codec-007

fields.label: p3109-codec-008

fields.label: p3109-codec-009

ceq [p3109-codec-010] : decodePositive(F, C) = (C rem (2 ^ (PrecisionOf(F) - 1))) * pow2(2 - PrecisionOf(F) - ExponentBiasOf(F)) if C >= 0 /\ C < 2 ^ (PrecisionOf(F) - 1) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .

fields.label: p3109-codec-011
fields.rhs: (1 + (C rem (2 ^ (PrecisionOf(F) - 1))) * pow2(1 - PrecisionOf(F))) * pow2((C quo (2 ^ (PrecisionOf(F) - 1))) - ExponentBiasOf(F))

records.text: ceq [p3109-codec-011] : decodePositive(F, C) = (1 + (C rem (2 ^ (PrecisionOf(F) - 1))) * pow2(1 - PrecisionOf(F))) * pow2((C quo (2 ^ (PrecisionOf(F) - 1))) - ExponentBiasOf(F)) if C >= 2 ^ (PrecisionOf(F) - 1) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .
ceq [p3109-codec-012] : datum(F, X) = false if not validFormat(F) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .
ceq [p3109-codec-013] : datum(F, X) = externalDatum(F, X) if validFormat(F) /\ not internalFormat(F) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .
ceq [p3109-codec-014] : datum(F, nan) = true if validFormat(F) /\ internalFormat(F) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .
ceq [p3109-codec-015] : datum(F, posInf) = (DomainOf(F) == Extended) if validFormat(F) /\ internalFormat(F) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .

ceq [p3109-codec-016] : datum(F, negInf) = (DomainOf(F) == Extended and SignednessOf(F) == Signed) if validFormat(F) /\ internalFormat(F) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .
ceq [p3109-codec-017] : datum(F, fin(R)) = false if validFormat(F) /\ internalFormat(F) /\ R < 0 /\ SignednessOf(F) == Unsigned [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .
ceq [p3109-codec-018] : datum(F, fin(0)) = true if validFormat(F) /\ internalFormat(F) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .

fields.label: p3109-codec-019
fields.condition: validFormat(F) /\ internalFormat(F) /\ R =/= 0 /\ (R > 0 or SignednessOf(F) == Signed)

records.text: ceq [p3109-codec-019] : datum(F, fin(R)) = candidateDatum(F, abs(R), magnitudeCode(F, abs(R))) if validFormat(F) /\ internalFormat(F) /\ R =/= 0 /\ (R > 0 or SignednessOf(F) == Signed) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .

fields.label: p3109-codec-020
fields.rhs: floor(R * pow2((PrecisionOf(F) - 1) - E)) + (if E == (1 - ExponentBiasOf(F)) and R < pow2(E) then 0 else ((E + ExponentBiasOf(F)) - 1) * (2 ^ (PrecisionOf(F) - 1)) fi)

records.text: ceq [p3109-codec-020] : magnitudeCode(F, R) = floor(R * pow2((PrecisionOf(F) - 1) - E)) + (if E == (1 - ExponentBiasOf(F)) and R < pow2(E) then 0 else ((E + ExponentBiasOf(F)) - 1) * (2 ^ (PrecisionOf(F) - 1)) fi) if R > 0 /\ E := max(floorLog2(R), 1 - ExponentBiasOf(F)) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .

fields.label: p3109-codec-021
fields.condition: C < 0 or C > positiveLimit(F) or (DomainOf(F) == Extended and C == positiveLimit(F))

fields.label: p3109-codec-022

records.text: ceq [p3109-codec-022] : candidateDatum(F, R, C) = xEq(decode(F, C), fin(R)) if C >= 0 /\ C <= positiveLimit(F) /\ (DomainOf(F) == Finite or C < positiveLimit(F)) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .
ceq [p3109-codec-023] : encode(F, X) = externalEncode(F, X) if validFormat(F) /\ not internalFormat(F) /\ datum(F, X) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .
ceq [p3109-codec-024] : encode(F, nan) = nanCode(F) if validFormat(F) /\ internalFormat(F) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .
ceq [p3109-codec-025] : encode(F, posInf) = positiveLimit(F) if validFormat(F) /\ internalFormat(F) /\ datum(F, posInf) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .
ceq [p3109-codec-026] : encode(F, negInf) = 2 ^ BitwidthOf(F) - 1 if validFormat(F) /\ internalFormat(F) /\ datum(F, negInf) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .
ceq [p3109-codec-027] : encode(F, fin(0)) = 0 if validFormat(F) /\ internalFormat(F) [metadata "clause=3.1; 4.7.2; 4.7.6; 4.8; page=16; 25; 30-31"] .

fields.label: p3109-codec-028
fields.rhs: magnitudeCode(F, abs(R)) + (if R < 0 then 2 ^ (BitwidthOf(F) - 1) else 0 fi)
